title: Dormitory
summary: Check-in rules, accommodation fees and documents for non-local students.

body.text: The university provides dormitory accommodation for non-local and international students. Places are allocated according to student categories and available capacity.

items: Submit an application to the faculty or student affairs office.
Prepare your passport, enrolment certificate and medical documents.
Read the accommodation and safety rules.

body.text: Accommodation fees and contacts are available in Student Life → Dormitory.
